name: PERSON-SOLO1 observed 25-hour drift with transient biphasic sleep

resolution.note: After the mature biphasic stage, the second sleep episode gradually disappeared while becoming more temporally stretched/separated.

sleep_architecture.note: The sleep episode gradually split into two approximately equal bouts; a 2-3 hour waking interval appeared; later the second bout gradually faded while stretching/separating in time.

historical_caffeine.description: Earlier period: typically 1-2 coffees every day.

current_caffeine.description: Current period: up to 3-4 coffees per week.

calibration_scope: Wake observations identify phase drift; sleep architecture identifies split, mature biphasic state and later secondary-bout resolution. Caffeine frequency is observed qualitatively, but dose and timing are not; no causal inference is encoded.
